target_customer: Engineering and platform teams that run observability at scale, including teams monitoring AI agent workflows and wanting telemetry in their own object storage
problem: Telemetry volumes are growing fast, and proprietary observability storage is costly and locks customers in. Limnion offers open-standards storage so data stays in the customer's own object store.
business_model: Open-source core (Siglake, Apache 2.0) with planned commercial BYOC platform and anomaly detection layer

founders.name: Todd (surname not stated in sources opened)
founders.role: Founder (signs the YC launch post; YC founder list was blank)
previous_startups: InfluxData (YC W13, co-founder per launch post)
Era Software (co-founder, acquired by ServiceNow per launch post)
founders.background_notes: Background taken from the launch post summary on the YC company page; the page does not formally list him as founder, so this is a reading of the byline. Education not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a production telemetry lake on OTel, Parquet, Iceberg and DataFusion needs database engineering depth, but the founder has about 15 years in observability per the YC launch post and builds on open components.

defensibility.rationale: The stack is built from open standards and Apache 2.0 code, so copying is possible; the edge would come from execution, community and the commercial layers still in development.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several vendors shipped lakehouse style telemetry products in 2026 (Imply Lumi Loglake in June 2026, Cribl Lakehouse, Coralogix telemetry lake), so the wedge was already contested.

market_need_then: Observability cost and lock-in complaints, plus growing telemetry from agentic systems, drove vendors to move telemetry into open lakehouse formats in 2026.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain technical tone: telemetry storage built for the agentic era

brand_strength.rationale: Very new brand with a distinct name but no press about the brand itself found; the open source project name differs from the company name.

outcome_analysis: Limnion is a brand new Fall 2026 company with no outcome yet. Its site lists array.vc, Foundation Capital and Y Combinator as backers without amounts. The open source Siglake project and the founder's long observability career are strengths, while established vendors already sell competing lakehouse telemetry products.
notes: The company site lists backers array.vc, Foundation Capital and Y Combinator but gives no amounts, dates or stage, so no round is recorded.
